content.en: Algorithms play a crucial role in addressing various research questions related to securing cyber-physical systems against adversarial attacks. These algorithms can detect and correct attacks, improve system resilience, estimate the state of the system despite attacks, and defend against denial-of-service (DoS) attacks in networked control systems. They can also achieve control and estimation for time-varying systems under hybrid attacks, mitigate DoS and physical attacks in nonlinear network control systems, and ensure secure state estimation and control performance in the presence of false data injection attacks. Overall, algorithms provide effective solutions to protect cyber-physical systems from different types of attacks and ensure their reliable operation.
content.da: Algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i at adressere forskellige forskningsspørgsmål relateret til sikring af cyber-fysiske systemer mod fjendtlige angreb. Disse algoritmer kan opdage og rette angreb, forbedre systemets modstandsdygtighed, estimere systemets tilstand på trods af angreb og forsvare sig mod denial-of-service (DoS) angreb i netværkskontrolsystemer. De kan også opnå kontrol og estimering for tidsvarierende systemer under hybride angreb, mindske DoS og fysiske angreb i ikke-lineære netværkskontrolsystemer og sikre sikker tilstandsestimering og kontrolpræstation i nærvær af falske dataindsprøjtningangreb. Samlet set giver algoritmer effektive løsninger til at beskytte cyber-fysiske systemer mod forskellige typer angreb og sikre deres pålidelige drift.

critic.en: Oh, the glory of algorithms! They're like our superheroes, swooping in to save the day for cyber-physical systems. But let's face it, the reliance on algorithms as the ultimate solution to cybersecurity challenges is not without its own set of risks and vulnerabilities. In fact, the complexity and interconnectedness of these systems often make it difficult to anticipate and counter all possible threats. So, while algorithms certainly have their place, perhaps we should be cautious in assuming they are the panacea for all cybersecurity woes.
critic.da: Jamen, det er jo præcis den slags oversalg, som gør mig skeptisk. Hvad med alle de potentielle risici og uforudsete konsekvenser, der følger med?

potential.en: I believe that advanced deep learning models, such as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, have shown great promise in enhancing cybersecurity. These models are well-suited for analyzing the temporal dynamics of cyber-physical systems data and detecting anomalous patterns that may indicate the presence of an attack. By training these deep learning models on large amounts of labeled data, it is possible to create highly accurate intrusion detection systems that can help protect critical infrastructure from cyber threats. Was that a good summary of the potential of deep learning in cybersecurity in a nutshell?
potential.da: Jeg synes, det er fantastisk, hvordan algoritmer kan give os en proaktiv tilgang til cybersikkerhed. I stedet for bare at reagere på angreb, kan vi nu forudsige, detektere og endda forhindre dem. Dette er især vigtigt for cyberfysiske systemer, hvor konsekvenserne af et angreb kan være vidtrækkende. Algoritmerne giver os ikke kun en følelse af sikkerhed, men hjælper også med at opbygge tillid til teknologien og digitaliseringen. Vi skal støtte og investere i udviklingen af disse algoritmer, så vi kan være på forkant med truslerne og sikre en pålidelig og sikker drift af vores systemer.
